related_questions.question: What does pan mean in cancer?

text_blocks.snippet: "Pancancer" refers to the analysis of multiple cancer types to identify commonalities and differences in their genomic and cellular characteristics, aiming to improve understanding of cancer biology and potentially lead to more effective diagnostic and treatment strategies. This approach is also known as pan-cancer analysis.
snippet_highlighted_words: refers to the analysis of multiple cancer types to identify commonalities and differences in their genomic and cellular characteristics

list.title: Focus on shared mechanisms:
list.snippet: Pancancer studies explore genomic and cellular alterations that are frequently observed across different cancer types, regardless of their origin.

list.title: Identification of unique traits:
list.snippet: Researchers also examine how cancers differ, looking for tumor-specific characteristics that might influence treatment response or disease progression.
